raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

In a multi-node engine, only node rank 0 owns the tokenizer manager and can drain in-flight requests and broadcast `ShutdownReq` to every scheduler. Non-zero node ranks therefore install a SIGTERM handler that only logs a warning and waits for that broadcast. Today that handler is a closure defined inline in `Engine._launch_subprocesses`, so an `Engine` subclass that wants a different follower behaviour on SIGTERM (for example, notifying rank 0 so it starts its normal drain instead of letting the orchestrator's kill timeout tear the whole engine down) has no way to change it without copying the entire `_launch_subprocesses` body.

## Modifications

- `python/sglang/srt/entrypoints/engine.py`: move the inline `sigterm_handler` closure to a classmethod, `Engine._handle_follower_sigterm(cls, signum, frame)`, and register `cls._handle_follower_sigterm` as the SIGTERM handler at the same point, under the same main-thread guard. The handler body is unchanged (same warning text), so the base `Engine` behaves exactly as before; only subclasses gain an override point.

No behaviour change, no new flags, no new dependencies.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable: no model forward, kernel, or sampling code is touched.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable: the change only relocates a signal handler definition that runs once at process start.

## Testing

- `python3 -m py_compile python/sglang/srt/entrypoints/engine.py` passes.
- The `+`/`-` lines are a pure hoist of the existing closure; the handler is installed under the same `threading.current_thread() is threading.main_thread()` condition as before.

- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -1125,6 +1125,17 @@ def _set_startup_time(
             startup_time["tokenizer_e2e"],
         )
 
+    @classmethod
+    def _handle_follower_sigterm(cls, signum, frame) -> None:
+        # Non-zero ranks cannot drain on their own: rank 0 stops every TP rank
+        # via the ShutdownReq broadcast, and the orchestrator's kill timeout is
+        # the backstop. Subclasses may override this to ask rank 0 to drain.
+        logger.warning(
+            f"SIGTERM received on node_rank {get_parallel().node_rank}; "
+            "waiting for the rank-0 ShutdownReq broadcast to stop "
+            "the schedulers."
+        )
+

     def _launch_subprocesses(
         cls,

                 )
 
-            # Non-zero ranks cannot drain on their own: rank 0 stops every TP rank
-            # via the ShutdownReq broadcast, and the orchestrator's kill timeout is

             if threading.current_thread() is threading.main_thread():
